section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the participants of a single cross-sectional study, which included 256 undergraduate female students from a public university in the UAE. The participants, all of Arab descent and Muslim, had a mean age of 20.35 years and a mean self-reported BMI of 22.98.
section_summary.evidence_source: 2.1 Participants This study employed a cross-sectional survey design and a convenience sample of 256 undergraduate female students enrolled at a large, public university in the UAE. Participants were recruited from undergraduate psychology and general education courses and received course credit for participation. Participants ranged in age from 18 to 26 (M = 20.35 years, SD = 1.81) and in self-reported BMI from 14.27 to 49.42 kg/m2 (M = 22.98, SD = 5.01). The sample was ethnically homogenous, all participants were of Arab descent, and identified as Muslim.
